paragraphs.text: Hello! My name is Omar.
And this is my very special barn.
You'll learn its secret soon.
But first let's meet Polly and Jack.
They live on the farm.
Minnie: Ahh. Everyone ate breakfast!
Now it's my turn to eat.
Uh-oh. What's Polly doing?
Polly: Out of my way!
Gary: Polly! No running in the coop!
You'll wake up the chicks!
Polly: No, I won't.
Chicks: Peep! Peep! Peep! Peep!
Gary: Minnie! Polly woke up the chicks!
Minnie: Polly, no running in the coop.
Polly: I want to be a fast runner.
So I have to practice.
Minnie: Polly, watch out for Jack!
Jack: Whoa!
Minnie: Jack, watch out for the nests!
Jack: Oops.
Minnie: Jack! You knocked over the hens' eggs.
Jack: Sorry.
Minnie: That's it! You two need jobs.
Hmm. The old barn needs fixing.
Polly: Yuck!
Jack: That's a lot of work!
Minnie: Yes, it is.
First you both can clean it. Now go.
Gary: And don't hurry back! Honk!
Look who's coming to my barn!
It's Polly and Jack!
I have a surprise for them.
Polly: Ugh! This barn is dusty!
Jack: It's dirty too!
Polly: Here's a broom. Now you can sweep.
Jack: That's not fair. Minnie told us to clean!
Polly: I don't like cleaning.
Jack: Me neither.
Omar: Hoot! Hoot!
Polly: Oh, an owl lives here.
Omar: Whooo are you?
Polly: Minnie told us not to talk to strangers.
Omar: I'm Omar.
Whooo are you?
Jack: I'm Jack.
Omar: And whooo are you?
Polly: Your barn is dirty, Omar.
Jack: That's not nice, Polly.
Minnie told us to be polite.
Omar: Never mind.
Whooo are you?
Polly: Fine. I’m Polly.
Omar: It's time to get to work.
Polly: What's happening?
Jack: The walls are shaking!
Polly: The air is sparkling!
Jack: I'm scared!
Where are we? This isn't the barn.
Polly: Oh. The barn turned into a straw house!
The Big Bad Wolf: Let me in!
Or I'll blow down your house!
Oh boy. Polly and Jack have a problem.
A big, bad wolf problem!
The Big Bad Wolf: Little pig, little pig, let me in!
Polly: Pigs? We're not pigs!
Jack: And we won't let you in.
The Big Bad Wolf: Then I'll blow your house down!
Polly: Uh-oh. This house is made of straw.
He can blow it down.
Jack: Help us, Omar! What should we do?
Omar: You can find the answer.
What can't the wolf blow down?
Jack: He can't blow down . . . wood?
Polly: Hey! My coop is made of wood!
Jack: The walls are shaking again.
Polly: We're in a coop now!
Jack: It's made of wood. We're safe in here.
The Big Bad Wolf: Ha-ha! I can blow that down!
Jack: Let's make a burrow in the ground!
Polly: Whew! We're safe in this burrow now.
Jack: No! The wolf is still there!
He's digging into the burrow!
Will Polly and Jack stop the Big Bad Wolf?
Or will he get them?
Polly and Jack are trapped in the burrow.
And here comes the wolf!
What will they do?
Polly: The wolf is in the burrow!
We need a new plan.
Jack: I'll stop him.
I'll kick dirt with my big feet.
The Big Bad Wolf: I can't see!
There's dirt in my eyes!
Polly: That was close.
Good work, Jack!
Jack: We need a new house. Right now!
Polly: Oh! What about a brick house?
Jack: Yes! A brick house is strong!
The Big Bad Wolf: Let me in!
Jack: No.
Polly: We will not let you in.
The Big Bad Wolf: Fine. I will blow down your house.
Huff! Puff!
Polly: Ha! Nice try!
The Big Bad Wolf: Ugh! This brick house is too strong.
I can't blow it down!
Polly: Hooray! The wolf left.
Jack: That was scary.
Omar: Good work!
Polly: Huh? We're back in the barn.
Jack: The floor is clean.
Minnie: Polly, Jack! It's time for lunch.
Polly: We have to go now.
That was fun!
Jack: Yes! Good-bye, Omar.
Omar: Good-bye. Come back soon!
Today is a fun day at the farm.
What does Minnie have?
I hope it's a treat!
Minnie: Everyone, come to the yard.
Suki, Sally, Sara: We're here!
What's wrong, Minnie?
Minnie: Nothing is wrong.
I have cookies for everyone!
Everyone: Yay! Yum!
Suki, Sally, Sara: Oh no. Here comes trouble!
Minnie: Slow down, Polly!
Polly: I'm chasing a butterfly.
I'm good at chasing things!
Suki, Sally, Sara: That's not very nice.
Leave the butterfly alone.
Minnie: Where's Jack?
Jack: Here I am.
Suki, Sally, Sara: Ahh! You scared us!
Jack: Sorry about that.
Polly: I'm good at scaring sheep too! Boo!
Suki, Sally, Sara: Bah! Bah! Bah!
Minnie: Who wants a cookie?
Everyone: Me!
Polly: Mmm, fwankwoo!
Jack: That's not very polite.
Minnie: Manners, please, Polly.
No talking with food in your mouth.
Now, everyone, back to work.
Jack: What should we do?
Minnie: Hmm. You two can go to the old barn.
Please clear away the cobwebs.
Polly: Okay! Come on, Jack.
Jack: I didn't eat my cookie yet.
Polly: Bring it, and let's go!
Here come the two little troublemakers again.
Hmm. What does Jack have?
Is that a . . . cookie?
Polly: Hurry up, Jack.
Jack: I'm coming.
But I don't want to drop my cookie.
Polly: Why don't you eat it now?
Jack: I want to save it for later.
Omar: Whooo are you?
Polly: You know us, Omar!
Omar: Whooo are you?
Jack: Hi! I'm Jack. That's Polly.
Omar: Whooo are you?
Polly: Jack just told you.
Why aren't the walls shaking?
Omar: Whooo are you?
Jack: Why don't you answer him?
Polly: Oh. I get it!
Hi! I'm Polly.
Jack: Now the walls are shaking.
Polly: Look! We're in a kitchen.
Jack: I smell something.
It smells like Minnie's cookies.
Polly: Where's your cookie, Jack?
Jack: Huh? It's gone!
Polly: Where did it go?
Jack: I don't know.
Polly: Shh. I hear something.
Oh! There's your cookie!
It's running away!
Jack: Hey! Come back here!
Polly, let's catch that cookie!
Oh my! Jack's cookie is running away fast!
Can Polly and Jack catch it?
Polly: The cookie just ran outside!
Jack: Come back here!
I want my cookie!
Gingerbread Man: Run as fast as you can!
You can't catch me!
I'm the gingerbread man! Ha-ha!
Polly: I'll get it for sure!
I'm faster than the cookie!
Jack: The cookie is fast too!
Polly: Oh no! The cookie is faster than me!
Jack: We have to keep chasing it!
Gingerbread Man: Ha-ha! You can't catch me!
Polly: It's running into that field!
Jack: There's a horse.
Jack: Can you help us?
Horse: I'm very fast. I'll catch that cookie!
Horse: Ugh! The cookie is faster than me.
Gingerbread Man: Ha-ha! The horse can't catch me either!
Polly: The cookie is getting away!
Jack: It's running up that hill.
Hawk: Eee! Eee! Eee! Eee!
Polly: Oh no! There's a big hawk.
Jack: The hawk sees the cookie.
It's swooping down!
Yikes! That hawk looks very hungry!
Who will catch the cookie first?
Polly and Jack—or the hungry hawk?
Gingerbread Man: Fly as fast as you can, Hawk!
I'm the gingerbread man!
You can't catch me!
Hawk: Oh yes, I can!
Jack: Stop! That's my cookie.
Hawk: Not anymore. It's my cookie now!
Polly: The hawk caught your cookie!
Jack: Hey! Give me back my cookie!
Polly: Oh! I've got an idea.
We'll hide behind the tree.
Jack: Huh? Then what?
Polly: When the hawk lands . . . Boo! We'll scare him away!
Jack: Will it work?
Polly: Of course it will.
Jack: Here comes the hawk.
Polly: One. Two. Three. Go!
Jack: Boo!
Polly: Shoo!
Hawk: Eee! Eee!
Jack: Yay! The hawk is gone!
Polly: We scared it away!
Gingerbread Man: You saved me!
Jack: Of course we did!
Polly: Look, Jack. We're back in the barn.
Jack: The cobwebs are gone.
Polly: Oh! And there's your cookie.
Jack: Yum!
Omar: Excuse me.
Are you going to share the cookie?
Jack: You can't catch me!
I'm fast—like the gingerbread man!
Planting season is very busy on the farm.
This morning everyone is ready to work.
Except for two little animals . . .
Minnie: It's time to plant vegetables.
There's lots of work to do.
Elvin: I'll dig some holes.
Suki, Sally, Sara: We'll plant the seeds.
Elvin: Where are Polly and Jack?
Suki, Sally, Sara: They're probably making trouble again.
They're always making trouble.
Minnie: Don't worry.
I have a special job for them.
Jack! Polly! Please come here.
Polly: Hi, Minnie!
Did you see how fast I ran?
Now watch me spin around!
Minnie: Be careful, Polly.
You might get dizzy.
Polly: I won't get dizzy.
Oh! Here comes Jack.
Suki, Sally, Sara: Jack knocked over a bucket of seeds!
Jack: Oops. Sorry, Minnie.
I'll clean up the mess.
Minnie: Yes, please clean up the seeds.
Then both of you—go to the old barn.
Please pull up all the weeds there.
Polly: We're on our way!
Minnie: Ahh . . .
Polly and Jack are back.
A new adventure is waiting for them.
It's going to be a big surprise!
Polly: Omar! We're here.
Jack: Ugh. I'm really itchy.
Polly: Hello! Omar, are you here? Hello? Hello?
I wonder where he is.
Jack: I wonder why I'm so itchy today.
Polly: You still have seeds in your fur.
I'll help you get rid of them. Here.
Jack: Thanks, Polly. I feel better now.
Polly: Oh! There's Omar! Hi, Omar!
Omar: Whooo are you?
Polly: You're funny. It's us!
Jack: Don't you remember us?
Omar: Whooo are you?
Polly: Oh! We have to remind him—every time!
Jack: My name is Jack!
Polly: And my name is Polly.
Jack: The air is sparkling!
Polly: The floor is shaking!
Jack: Whoa! Something is growing out of the floor.
Polly: It's a plant.
And it's growing really fast!
Jack: It's a giant beanstalk!
I wonder what is at the top.
Polly: Let's climb up and see what's there!
Jack and Polly are still climbing up, up, up.
They are about to find a giant surprise!
Jack: I'm tired.
Polly: Keep going.
We're almost at the top!
Jack: Wow! Look at this house!
Everything is so big!
Polly: This house is bigger than the farmer's.
Jack: Look at this chair!
It's big enough for my whole family!
Polly: This table is bigger than the coop!
Jack: And look at all this food!
Polly: Let's eat!
Jack: This cake looks yummy.
Carrot cake is my favorite.
Polly: Apple pie is my favorite.
Jack: Someone's coming!
Polly: It's a giant! Quick! Hide!
Giant: Fee, fi, fo, fum!
I smell a chicken and a rabbit!
Jack: I'm scared.
Polly: Me too!
Giant: Someone ate my dinner!
Come out right now!
I'll squash you!
Jack: What do we do?
Polly: We have to escape!
Fee, fi, fo, fum!
Polly and Jack are in big, big trouble!
Polly and Jack are hiding.
Will the giant find them?
Giant: Fee, fi, fo, fum!
I smell strangers in my house!
Polly: Run, Jack!
Jack: I'm not fast like you.
Polly: I have an idea.
Jack: Be careful, Polly.
Polly: Surprise!
Giant: A chicken! I knew it!
Polly: You can't catch me!
Giant: Whoa! I'm getting dizzy.
Polly: Ha-ha! Try to grab me, Giant!
Giant: Whoa. Oof!
Jack: The giant fell down!
Polly: Hurry. Let's go.
Jack: There's the beanstalk.
Polly: Whew. We made it.
Uh-oh. The giant is coming!
Jack: I'll cut the beanstalk with my teeth!
Now he can't follow us.
Polly: We did it!
We stopped the giant!
Jack: We're back in the barn.
Polly: Omar? Where are you?
Omar: Fe, fi, fo, fum!
Jack: Oh no! The giant followed us!
Omar: It's me! Good work.
Polly: Ugh! You scared us!
Jack: The giant really scared us!
Omar: The weeds are all gone.
Polly: Wow! Can we come back again?
Omar: Of course! There's plenty more work to do.
It's a rainy day at the farm.
I see lots of mud!
Minnie: No work today.
The field is too muddy.
We'll stay inside today.
We can all get some extra sleep.
Elvin: I really like sleeping.
I'm glad it's rainy today.
Gary: I'm not. I like working.
Minnie: No more work until the rain stops.
Elvin: I hope it's rainy all day.
Gary: I hope it's sunny soon.
Elvin: I'm going back to bed. Yippee!
Gary: Shh! Don't be so noisy!
Minnie: Where are you two going?
Jack: We're going to the old barn.
Polly: Yeah. We want to clean.
Minnie: It's too rainy. Stay here today.
Polly: NO!
Minnie: Excuse me?
Jack: She means, "No, thank you."
Polly: Right. We want to see Om—
I mean, we want to clean.
Minnie: You two like cleaning a lot.
Jack: We really like cleaning!
Polly: So, can we go? Please!
Minnie: I guess so. Watch out for puddles.
Polly: Yay! Thanks, Minnie!
Minnie: Have fun.
Here come Polly and Jack.
Hmm. The fireplace looks very dirty.
Polly: This is fun!
Jack: That puddle looks very big.
Polly: Wow! Jump over it.
Jack: I'll try.
Now I'm all wet.
Polly: You can dry off inside.
Omar: You're back.
Polly: We love it here!
Jack: What should we do today?
Oh! We can clean that dirty fireplace.
Polly: We love to help you, Omar.
Omar: You are very kind.
Polly: Look! The air is sparkling!
Jack: We're in an old house.
And we have wands.
Polly: I think we're fairies.
Oh! There's a girl sewing by the fireplace.
Jack: Someone's coming.
Stepmother: Cinderella! We're going to the prince's ball now.
Did you finish cleaning?
Cinderella: Yes, Stepmother. May I go too?
Stepmother: You? Never! You're staying here.
You can clean the fireplace. Bye.
Jack: Hello. Your stepmother is mean.
Cinderella: Who are you?
Polly: I'm Polly, and this is Jack.
Maybe we can help you!
Poor Cinderella. Can Polly and Jack help her?
Huh? Are those magic wands?
Cinderella: You're very kind.
I really want to go to the ball.
But I have nothing nice to wear.
Polly: You need a pretty dress.
I'll use this wand.
Jack: Uh-oh. That's not a dress.
Polly: Oops. It's a knight's armor.
Jack: Hmm. Maybe you waved the wand too fast.
Let me try.
Polly: You waved it too slowly.
She's wearing Minnie's clothes.
Try again.
Jack: Okay.
Cinderella: Oh my! What a beautiful dress!
Polly: Oh. Now you need shoes.
Jack: Those are cowboy boots. I'll try!
Polly: Jack, those are soccer shoes. I'll try again.
Jack: Nice work, Polly. She has glass shoes now!
Cinderella: Thank you!
Jack: We like helping.
Polly: You're all ready for the ball! Let's go.
Cinderella: How will I get there?
Jack: There's no carriage here.
Polly: What should we do?
Cinderella is all dressed up.
But how will she get to the ball?
Uh-oh. Will Cinderella miss the ball?
Jack: Can we walk to the castle?
Cinderella: The castle is too far away.
I guess I have to stay home.
Jack: Don't give up, Cinderella.
Polly: Oh! Your old dress turned into a beautiful dress.
Cinderella: And my old shoes turned into glass shoes.
Jack: Hmm. Maybe that pumpkin can turn into a carriage.
Cinderella: It's beautiful!
Polly: Nice work, Jack.
Jack: But now we need horses to pull it.
Polly: Excuse me, mice.
Would you mind helping Cinderella?
Thank you.
Jack: The mice turned into horses!
Cinderella: Now I can go to the ball!
Jack: Yay! Have fun!
Polly: Don't stay out too late!
Cinderella: Thank you for your help!
Jack: No problem!
Polly: The air is sparkling.
Omar: Welcome back. The fireplace is clean now.
Jack: Wow! Too bad we missed the ball.
Polly: Let's dance home, Jack.
Jack: Okay. But I don't want to get wet again.
Omar: Watch out for puddles!

17.title: A Busy Day on the Farm

paragraphs.text: It's another busy day on the farm.
Everyone has a job to do.
Minnie: Whew! I swept the whole barn.
Now I'll check on everyone else's work.
Suki, Sally, Sara: We're watering the vegetables.
Vincent: I'm pulling all the weeds.
Elvin: I'm fixing the broken fence.
Minnie: What are you doing, Gary?
Gary: I'm busy too.
Minnie: You are?
Gary: Yes, I'm making sure everyone is working.
Where are Jack and Polly?
Minnie: They're laying new hay in the chicken coop.
Gary: Polly isn't working! She's running over here.
Minnie: Slow down, Polly.
Polly: Can Jack and I go to the old barn?
Minnie: Did you finish your job?
Polly: Um . . . yes! We're all done.
Minnie: Hmm. Then you may go.
Polly: Yay!
Jack: Polly, where did you go?
Polly: I went to see Minnie.
She said we can go to Omar's barn. Yay!
Jack: But we didn't finish laying the hay.
Polly: That's okay. We can do it later.
Jack: Great! Let's go.
Polly and Jack are running into my barn.
I thought they were cleaning the farm today.
Polly: Hi, Omar, we're here!
Jack: Hello!
Omar: Don't you have chores around the farm?
Polly: We'll finish them later.
Jack: Minnie told Polly it was okay.
What should we do today?
Omar: That pile of wood must be stacked.
Polly: We love working here!
Omar: Is that true?
Jack: I always tell the truth.
Omar: Good. What about you, Polly?
Polly: Uh, yes.
Omar: Hmm . . . It's important to tell the truth.
Jack: The air is sparkling!
Polly: We're in a woodworker's shop.
Jack: Look at that fox puppet!
Polly: Oh! It looks fun.
Jack: Be careful, Polly.
Polly: Don't worry. It will be fine.
Jack: Huh? Did you hear that crack?
Polly: I didn't hear anything.
Jack: Hmm. I'll go check outside.
Polly: Whew!
Cat: I'm Cat. I'm here to pick up a fox puppet.
Polly: Uh . . . Someone else bought it. Sorry, Cat!
Cat: My boss isn't going to be happy!
Polly didn't tell Cat the truth.
What will Cat's boss do?
Jack: What did Cat want?
Polly: Nothing.
Jack: Huh? Did your beak just grow?
Polly: No.
Fox: Geppetto! Where are you?
Geppetto: It's nice to see you, Mr. Fox.
Fox: Cat said my puppet was sold.
You sold my puppet to someone else!
Geppetto: I wouldn't do that. It's right here.
Fox: I'll be back in two hours.
Make sure my puppet is here.
Or I'll tell everyone you're a liar.
Geppetto: I don't understand. Where is it?
Did you two see a fox puppet?
Jack: Uhh . . .
Polly: Nope!
Geppetto: I left it on the shelf.
This will ruin my business!
Jack: You were playing with a puppet, Polly.
Polly: No, I wasn't.
Jack: Your beak grew again.
Polly: No, it didn't.
Jack: Polly, you keep telling lies.
And every time you lie, your beak grows!
Oh boy! Polly's lies are getting bigger.
And so is her beak!
Geppetto has to find Mr. Fox's puppet.
Or Mr. Fox will ruin his business.
Can Polly help him?
Geppetto: I can't find the puppet anywhere!
Mr. Fox will tell everyone I'm a liar.
This is terrible.
Jack: You have to tell Geppetto the truth.
Polly: But he'll get mad at me.
Jack: He's in trouble because you lied!
Polly: Um. Excuse me.
I hid the puppet in this drawer.
Geppetto: Why did you do that?
Polly: Because I broke it.
I'm so sorry. And I'm sorry I lied.
Geppetto: Hmm. The crack isn't too bad. I can fix it.
Jack: You can?
Geppetto: Yes. But you must promise something.
You must always tell the truth.
Polly: I promise!
Jack: We're back in the barn!
Wow! The wood is all stacked.
Polly: I still have work to do.
Omar: Laying hay in the coop?
Polly: Yes, and telling Minnie the truth.
Jack: Let's go, Polly! Bye, Omar!
It was a lazy afternoon on the farm.
Most of the animals were napping.
But Polly was looking for Jack.
Polly: Let's sneak off to the old barn.
Jack: It's not nice to sneak, Polly.
We should ask Minnie first.
Polly: You're right. Let's go ask Minnie.
Jack: Excuse me, Minnie.
May we go to the old barn today?
Minnie: Will you bother Omar?
Polly: Of course not. He likes us!
Jack: Besides, there's still work to do.
Polly: And we like working there.
Minnie: Hmm. Then you may go. Be back for supper.
Polly, Jack: Yay!
Gary: Minnie, something strange is going on.
Those two don't like to work!
Minnie: Sometimes they do.
Polly: Someone left a wagon here.
Let's take it to the barn!
Jack: But it's not ours.
Polly: We're just going to borrow it.
No one will mind.
Jack: Hmm. It does seem fun. Okay, let's take it.
Polly: Pull me to the barn!
Polly and Jack have a wagon.
Huh? I saw that wagon yesterday.
I don't think it belongs to them.
Polly: Good afternoon, Omar!
Jack: Hello, Omar! We're here.
Where are you, Omar?
Polly: We came to help you!
Jack: Hmm. I don't think he's here.
Polly: Oh no! Do you think he's gone?
Omar: Hello, Jack. Good afternoon, Polly.
Jack: Omar! You are here!
Polly: We're so happy to see you!
We want to work today.
Omar: Good. You can move those sacks of grain.
Jack: No problem!
Polly: We're happy to help.
Omar: Thank you!
Jack: Look! The air is sparkling, Polly!
Polly: We're in a house.
No one is home.
Jack: I see three beds in that room.
Polly: And there are three chairs here.
Jack: Huh? Look over there.
There are three bowls of porridge too.
Polly: I'm hungry!
Jack: Me too.
Polly: Can we eat some?
Jack: I don't know, Polly. It's not our porridge.
Polly: But no one is here.
I see Jack picking up a spoon.
Is he about to eat some porridge?
Jack: It smells so good.
And I am very hungry.
Maybe we could just eat a little.
Polly: Good idea. We won't eat too much.
Jack: This porridge is too hot.
Polly: This porridge is too cold.
Jack: Mmm. This is just right.
Polly: Mmm. It tastes so good.
Jack: I'm full now. We should go.
Someone might find us.
Polly: Eating all that porridge made me tired.
Jack: Me too. Maybe we could lie down.
Just for a few minutes.
Polly: Ugh. This bed is too hard.
Jack: Hmm. This bed is too soft.
Jack: Ahh. This bed is just right.
Polly: Yes.
Mama Bear: Roar! Who came into our house?
Papa Bear: Oh no! Could it be a g-ghost?
Baby Bear: I hope not!
Polly: Jack, wake up! Someone is here!
Jack: Yes, and they're . . . bears!
Uh-oh! Three bears live in this house.
And Mama Bear looks mad!
Jack and Polly are hiding.
Will the bears find them?
Papa Bear: Who was sitting in my chair?
Mama Bear: Who was sitting in my chair?
Baby Bear: Who ate my porridge?
Jack: The bears sound mad!
Polly: We have to get out of here.
Jack: But how? Bears are fast!
Polly: I'm fast too.
Jack: Well, I'm not!
Polly: That's true. Hmm . . . I have a plan.
Jack: Boo! Whooo! Whooo!
Polly: Whooo! Whooo!
Mama Bear: Aah! Ghosts!
Baby Bear: I'm scared!
Papa Bear: Me too! Everyone, hide!
Polly: Whooo! Whooo!
Baby Bear: Look! They're leaving.
Mama Bear: Those ghosts are strange.
Jack: Phew! Next time we won't eat their porridge!
Polly: Or sleep in their beds!
Jack: We're back in the barn.
Omar: The sacks are all moved.
Polly: Yay!
Jack: Phew! That was a scary adventure.
Polly: It sure was.
Jack: We should go.
We need to return the wagon.
Polly: You're right.
Minnie: Polly, Jack. It's time for supper!
Omar: What's for supper? Porridge?
Jack: Ugh! No way!
Polly: I hope not!
Well, that's interesting.
Polly is racing over to the chicken coop.
I wonder what's going on.
Polly: Hey, chicks! What are you doing?
Chicks: We're running races.
See how fast we are?
Polly: That's not fast. Watch this.
Out of my way!
Chicks: Peep! Peep!
Suki, Sally, Sara: The chicks are crying!
Polly, what are you doing?
Polly: I'm showing the chicks how to run.
Gary: Minnie! Polly's running in the coop again!
Minnie: Polly, no running in the coop!
Polly: The chicks ran.
Minnie: Yes, they did.
Polly: But they ran in the coop!
Why do they get to run inside?
Minnie: They can't run outside on the farm.
They're too small.
Polly: That's not fair.
Minnie: You get to do lots of other things.
You can do things they can't do.
Polly: Like what?
Jack: We get to go to the old barn.
Polly: Ah-ha! That's true. Can we go now, Minnie?
Minnie: Yes. Have fun!
Polly and Jack are coming.
I have a fun job for them today.
